# Harvard Business Review

> Harvard Business Review is the leading publication for executive insights on leadership, strategy, and organizational transformation in the age of AI.

HBR provides curated content across articles, podcasts, case studies, and webinars from top business experts and Harvard Business School faculty. The platform serves executives and leaders seeking actionable insights on strategy, talent management, and business innovation.

## Key Topics

- Leadership
- Business Strategy
- Organizational Transformation
- AI and Generative AI
- Management
- Talent Management
- Strategic Planning
- CEO Insights
- Entrepreneurship
- Career Development
- Professional Development
- Business Leadership
- Organizational Change
- Diversity and Inclusion
- Executive Development

## Core Content Hub

- [Harvard Business Review - Ideas and Advice for Leaders](https://hbr.org): HBR homepage featuring strategy, innovation, leadership ideas from top business experts
- [The Magazine - HBR](https://hbr.org/magazine): HBR magazine archive and current issues on AI transformation and business leadership
- [Harvard Business Review - The Latest](https://hbr.org/the-latest): Latest news roundup and articles on AI, leadership, entrepreneurship, and economic trends
- [All Topics - HBR](https://hbr.org/topics): Directory of all HBR topics including leadership, strategy, innovation, and management
- [Harvard Business Review - Executive Hub](https://hbr.org/executive): Executive hub featuring CEO insights, AI strategy, talent management, and business masterclasses

## Featured Topic Pages

- [Leadership - HBR](https://hbr.org/topic/leadership): Leadership topic page featuring management tips, AI leadership, and executive insights
- [Strategy - HBR](https://hbr.org/topic/strategy): Strategy topic page on business strategy, organizational transformation, and planning
- [Managing people - HBR](https://hbr.org/topic/managing-people): Managing people topic page on employee management, talent, and team building
- [Managing yourself - HBR](https://hbr.org/topic/managing-yourself): Topic page on self-management, career planning, and personal growth for leaders
- [Gender - HBR](https://hbr.org/topic/gender): Gender topic page on diversity, women leadership, and workplace inclusion research

## Audio & Video Resources

- [Podcasts](https://hbr.org/podcasts): HBR podcast directory featuring IdeaCast, Women at Work, and Coaching Real Leaders
- [Webinars](https://hbr.org/webinars): Webinars on AI, generative AI, leadership development, and organizational strategy

## Learning & Research Materials

- [Case Selections](https://hbr.org/case-selections): Business case studies from Harvard Business School featuring real-world leadership scenarios
- [Reading Lists](https://hbr.org/reading-lists): Curated reading lists on leadership, business topics, and professional development
- [Data & Visuals](https://hbr.org/data-visuals): Data visualizations and infographics on AI, analytics, and business strategy insights

## Subscriptions & Communications

- [Email Newsletters - HBR](https://hbr.org/email-newsletters): HBR email newsletters on leadership, management, and daily business alerts

## Optional

- [Sign In](https://hbr.org/my-library): User sign-in and account access page for HBR subscribers
- [Sign In](https://hbr.org/my-library/settings): Account settings and authentication page for HBR user management
